# Town of Waterville municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Waterville, Boards & Minutes page (watervillevt.org): lists the current Select Board -- Jay Marsh (Chair), L. Carlos Martin, and Christopher Mann. Concordant with the Secretary of State directory and the 2025 Town Report; Mann's report-listed term expired in 2026 but the live page presents him as a current member

Town of Waterville, Warning for the Annual Meeting, March 3, 2026: Article 2 elects the Town Clerk for one year, and Brandi Broe attests the warning as Town Clerk (January 26, 2026). Her seat stood in March 2026 with no published outcome; the Guide and both June 2026 Secretary of State spreadsheets list her as the current clerk (incumbent-continuity mint, disclosed on #163)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Brandi Broe as Waterville's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Brandi Broe as Waterville's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Brandi Broe as Waterville's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Brandi Broe as Waterville's Town Treasurer. Incumbent-continuity mint on the same basis as the clerk's office (disclosed on #163)

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator; Heather Thomas held the office into 2026 per the 2025 Town Report and the 2026 floor-vote outcome (Warning Art. 1) is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Waterville, 2026 Warning: Article 2 elects a Road Commissioner for one year -- an elected office in Waterville. Hunter Locke's term expired in 2026 per the 2025 Town Report and the outcome is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Town of Waterville, 2025 Town Report, 'Town Officers' list: lists Wanda Locke (term to 2027) and Dustin Tilton (term to 2028); Donna Barry's seat expired in 2026 -- straggler. Locke is also a Justice of the Peace; one record carries both

Town of Waterville, 2025 Town Report, 'Town Officers' list: the report's own list fixes the board at seven seats and names Annie Schools (to 2027), Kimberly Mann (to 2028), and Laurie Ferron (to 2028)

Town of Waterville, Boards & Minutes page: names the same three as the library board's Chair, Vice Chair, and Secretary. The page also names Lisa Towery (Treasurer), who is not in the report -- she may hold the seat warned in 2026 (Wade Chivington's), outcome unpublished; Towery and the report's three 2027 trustees absent from the page (Fairweather, Bressel, Nielson) are stragglers (disclosed on #163)

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns may elect a second constable; Warren Lyon held the office into 2026 per the 2025 Town Report; the 2026 outcome is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

jp_election.name: Town of Waterville Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the five winners of Waterville's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for five): William Baker, Trista Hutchins, Edna Lafountain, Wanda Locke, and Linda Ward. All five remain in office
